label: secondbeach15
title_zh: 冥王星从来就不是真正的行星

lines.en: label secondbeach15:
scene pluto1
And so I shall whisk you away, on wings of misery and malice, to our next destination.
lines.zh: 那么，就让我用痛苦与恶意织成的翅膀，把你带往下一个目的地。

lines.en: A place with more water than the last, but immensely less sexual curiosity or desire to slide one’s fingers inside of a friend.
lines.zh: 一个比上一個地方水更多的地——方，但其中的性好奇心、以及想把手指伸进朋友身体里的欲望，却少得多。

lines.en: It’s all fluid either way.
lines.zh: 反正都是流体。

lines.en: One example is just more literal than the other.
lines.zh: 只不过其中一个例子更字面一点。

lines.en: : I find myself in a place with a lower pixel count than normal.
lines.zh: : 我发现自己身处一个像素比平时更低的地方。

lines.en: : I narrate my thoughts because I am incapable of keeping them locked away.
lines.zh: : 我把自己的想法念出来，因为我没办法把它们锁在心里。

lines.en: : I am going to meet someone.
lines.zh: : 我要去见一个人。

lines.en: : The night has come and I have accepted it.
lines.zh: : 夜晚已经降临，而我接受了它。

lines.en: : My shoes got wet around a mile back and are now irritating a blister I developed from walking in circles for too long.
lines.zh: : 大约一英里前我的鞋湿了，现在正磨着因为绕圈子走太久而起的水泡。

lines.en: : I wonder if I am bleeding.
lines.zh: : 我在想自己是不是在流血。

lines.en: scene pluto2
I ʍoupǝɹ ᴉɟ I ɐɯ qlǝǝpᴉuƃ˙
lines.zh: I ʍoupǝɹ ᴉɟ I ɐɯ qlǝǝpᴉuƃ˙

lines.en: Narration slips back to where it’s supposed to be and I feel as if it had been all sorts of screwed up until just moments ago.
lines.zh: 旁白滑回了它本该在的位置，而我感觉直到片刻之前，它一直都是乱七八糟的。

lines.en: But that is fine, because I am on a mission.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为我身负使命。

lines.en: A mission to meet a girl.
lines.zh: 一个去见某个女生的使命。

lines.en: But which girl was it again?
lines.zh: 可到底是哪个女生来着？

lines.en: scene pluto1
Someone wanted to talk to me about something.
lines.zh: 有人想跟我说点什么事。

lines.en: I survey my surroundings.
lines.zh: 我打量起四周。

lines.en: I ask them questions about who they will be voting for in the next gravure poll.
lines.zh: 我问它们在下一届写真投票里会投给谁。

lines.en: It is quite literally a survey.
lines.zh: 这可是货真价实的一次调查。

lines.en: To my dismay, however, none of them are willing to speak.
lines.zh: 然而让我沮丧的是，没有一个对象愿意开口。

lines.en: Low resolution boulders just aren’t the same as they used to be.
lines.zh: 低分辨率的巨石，终究不是从前那个样子了。

lines.en: So I think of new resolutions.
lines.zh: 于是我开始琢磨新的分辨率。

lines.en: I remove a metaphorical pen from my real pocket and begin to draw.
lines.zh: 我从真实的口袋里掏出一支隐喻的笔，开始画画。

lines.en: scene pluto3
I don’t remember drawing ever being this hard.
lines.zh: 我不记得画画曾经这么难。

lines.en: But it’s not like I ever had the talent for this anyway.
lines.zh: 不过反正我也从来没有这方面的天赋。

lines.en: My hands tend to get bored a little too easily, and visual art is mundane.
lines.zh: 我的手太容易感到无聊，而视觉艺术又太乏味。

lines.en: Which is one of the two important reasons I decided to start writing instead.
lines.zh: 这是我当初选择写作而不是画画的两个重要理由之一。

lines.en: The second was buried many years ago.
lines.zh: 第二个理由在很多年前就被埋葬了。

lines.en: scene pluto4
I begin to fill the scene with color, and it’s a little easier to do that than making the outline.
lines.zh: 我开始给画面上色，这比画轮廓要容易一些。

lines.en: I use my spare time to doodle angry eyebrows and a frown over a set of rocks.
lines.zh: 我利用空闲时间，在一堆石头上涂了愤怒的眉毛和一张苦瓜脸。

lines.en: They’re angry because they can’t move and I can.
lines.zh: 它们生气，是因为它们动不了，而我能。

lines.en: Fuck you, rocks.
lines.zh: 去你的，石头。

lines.en: : What in the absolute fuck are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底在干什么？

lines.en: scene pluto5
: Yumi!
lines.zh: : Yumi！

lines.en: : ...Yeah? The fuck do you have to yell it for?
lines.zh: : ……干嘛？你他妈喊这么大声干嘛？

lines.en: : I was just excited to see you.
lines.zh: : 我只是见到你太激动了。

lines.en: scene pluto6
: Well...whatever.
lines.zh: : 行吧……随便。

lines.en: : Guess it only made sense that you wound up finding me. You always manage to do that somehow.
lines.zh: : 想想也是，你最后总会找到我。你总有办法做到这一点。

lines.en: {s}CONNECTION RESTORED{/s}
lines.zh: {s}连接已恢复{/s}

lines.en: : Maybe you just suck at hiding?
lines.zh: : 也许只是你太不会藏了？

lines.en: : Probably. Suck at pretty much everything else, so...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。反正我别的什么都很烂，所以……

lines.en: : Congrats, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那恭喜你了，大概。

lines.en: : So...you wanted to talk about something, right?
lines.zh: : 所以……你想跟我说点什么，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t really remember how I got here, but I’m pretty sure I can remember that.
lines.zh: : 我不太记得自己是怎么到这儿来的，但这件事我应该还记得。

lines.en: scene pluto7
: Shouldn’t you like...go to the doctor or some shit if your memory is that bad?
lines.zh: : 记忆力烂成这样，你不是该去看个医生什么的吗？

lines.en: : Sucks enough that you’re always fuckin’ turning into a zombie all the time. The least you could do is make sure it’s not fuckin’...terminal or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你动不动就他妈变成一具僵尸，已经够惨了。你至少该确认一下那玩意儿是不是……绝症什么的吧。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. Let’s just get this conversation out of the way so I can go do that sleepover thing or whatever it was I was supposed to do tonight.
lines.zh: : 我会没事的。先把这段对话解决掉，我好去办今晚本该办的那个留宿活动什么的。

lines.en: scene pluto8
if dormwarfloor1win == True:
: Ew, again? You literally just did that last night. Sleep in your own fucking room this time.
lines.zh: : 恶，又来？你昨晚才刚干过。这次他妈的睡自己房间去。

lines.en: else:
: What? Didn’t you do that last night?
lines.zh: : 什么？你昨晚没干那个吗？

lines.en: : In fact, I {i}know{/i} you did it last night because Chika wouldn’t shut the fuck up about it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我{i}知道{/i}你昨晚干了，因为 Chika 一直在他妈念叨个没完。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess I did do that last night.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我猜我昨晚确实干了。

lines.en: : Anyway, what’s-
lines.zh: : 总之，什么——

lines.en: scene pluto9
////////////////////////USER2 IS HAVING TROUBLE CONNECTING
////////////////////////IT APPEARS THAT MORE THAN ONE USER MAY BE LOGGED IN AT THE SAME TIME
////////////////////////PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL USERS ARE LOGGED OUT BEFORE TRYING AGAIN
////////////////////////PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL USERS ARE LOGGED OUT BEFORE TRYING AGAIN
: Yo. Come...back or whatever. No use fuckin’ talkin’ to you about this shit if it’s not really {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 喂。回{i}来{/i}什么的。要是那不是真的你，跟你聊这些屁事也没意义。

lines.en: : No, it’s me...everything just feels a little...
lines.zh: : 不，是我……只是感觉一切都有一点……

lines.en: : Wrong...
lines.zh: : 不对劲……

lines.en: scene pluto10
: That’s because everything is wrong.
lines.zh: : 因为一切都不对劲。

lines.en: : You’re dreaming right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在在做梦。

lines.en: : And when you wake up, you’ll be right back in your bed.
lines.zh: : 等你醒来，你就会回到自己的床上。

lines.en: : So why not use this opportunity to have a little fun?
lines.zh: : 所以为什么不趁这个机会找点乐子？

lines.en: : Fun...how?
lines.zh: : 乐子……怎么找？

lines.en: scene pluto11
: I guess we could like...make out or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我想我们可以……亲热一下什么的。

lines.en: : It’s a dream, so it’s okay.
lines.zh: : 反正是在梦里，没关系的。

lines.en: scene pluto12
: Making out isn't enough, huh?
lines.zh: : 光是亲热还不够，是吧？

lines.en: : Well...as long as it’s you...I wouldn’t mind-
lines.zh: : 嗯……只要是你的话……我也不介意——

lines.en: scene pluto13
: Hey.
: Hi.
scene frown
you have strayed too far
lines.zh: 你偏离得太远了

lines.en: i will guide you back
lines.zh: 我会把你带回来

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene contentwarning
scene lessons
scene everythingg
scene pluto14
I make it to the water level.
lines.zh: 我来到了水位线处。

lines.en: : So, uhh...we’re not just gonna stand here all night, are we?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们不会就这么站一晚上吧？

lines.en: : I figured if I managed to stay away from you for the rest of the trip that I could just dodge ever havin’ to talk about this, but you found me, so...
lines.zh: : 我本来想着，只要这趟旅行剩下的时间都躲着你，就能永远不用谈这件事，可你还是找到我了，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: You’re so wet right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在湿透了。

lines.en: scene pluto15
: Actually...on second thought, I think I’m gonna go. Peace.
lines.zh: : 算了……再想想，我还是走吧。回见。

lines.en: scene pluto16
: Wait. No.
lines.zh: : 等等。别。

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : Just...slap me if I start zoning out or something.
lines.zh: : 只是……要是我又开始发呆什么的，就扇我一下。

lines.en: scene pluto17
: That’s a dangerous privilege to give me, dude. You won’t be able to feel your face for the next year.
lines.zh: : 这特权给我可太危险了，老兄。接下来一年你都别想感觉到自己的脸了。

lines.en: : I kind of can’t feel it right now anyway, so it doesn’t really matter.
lines.zh: : 反正我现在本来就没什么感觉，所以也无所谓。

lines.en: : Just tell me what this apparently super important thing you needed to come clean about is and we can get on with our respective nights.
lines.zh: : 你就直接告诉我，你非得坦白的这件据说超级重要的事是什么，然后我们各自去过各自的夜晚吧。

lines.en: scene pluto18
: It’s not really...{i}coming clean{/i}...it’s more just...trying to figure out what’s real and what’s not...
lines.zh: : 也不算什么……{i}坦白{/i}……更像是……想弄清楚什么是真的、什么不是……

lines.en: : Which I’m sure sounds plenty fuckin’ weird to you, but...I don’t really know how else to word it.
lines.zh: : 我知道这话听起来肯定他妈的很怪，不过……我真不知道还能怎么说。

lines.en: : Did you want to-
lines.zh: : 你想——

lines.en: : Sit? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 坐下？嗯。

lines.en: : Come with me.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi walks right past me and steps into the water to avoid having to move me out of the way.
lines.zh: Yumi 径直从我身边走过，踏进水里，免得还得把我挪开。

lines.en: I wonder if she’ll regret that decision over the next hour or two when it begins to irritate her blisters as well.
lines.zh: 我在想，接下来一两个小时里，当水也开始磨她的水泡时，她会不会后悔这个决定。

lines.en: I’m sure there are quite a few of them, given how many circles she needs to go in just to survive.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她的水泡不少，毕竟为了活下去，她得绕那么多圈子。

lines.en: scene pluto19
We take our respective places on a rock not far from the natural archway we’d been positioned under just moments ago.
lines.zh: 我们在离刚才那座天然拱门不远的一块石头上各自坐下。

lines.en: And, as expected, several moments of silence pass by before either of us attempt to speak.
lines.zh: 不出所料，沉默了好一阵子，我们才有一方尝试开口。

lines.en: Yumi opens her mouth as if she’s going to say something, but closes it several seconds later when she remembers that she’s not supposed to tell me anything ever.
lines.zh: Yumi 张了张嘴，像是要说什么，几秒后又闭上了，因为她想起自己本来就不该告诉我任何事。

lines.en: I begin to wonder if this has something to do with my tendency to “lose myself” around her and then submit to the idea that I have no “self” and that those are just glimpses into another me.
lines.zh: 我开始怀疑，这会不会和我总是在她身边「迷失自我」有关，然后我又屈服于另一个念头——我根本没有「自我」，那些只是另一个我的惊鸿一瞥。

lines.en: Another me who, admittedly, struggles a bit more with rational thought-
lines.zh: 另一个我，说实话，理性思考的能力要差一些——

lines.en: But sees the world in a light much different than anyone else.
lines.zh: 但看世界的眼光，却和任何人都截然不同。

lines.en: Perhaps this is what it means to be a god.
lines.zh: 也许这就是身为神的意义。

lines.en: Or simply what it means to be- because god (Or me) knows that the way I normally live is far from meaningful.
lines.zh: 或者仅仅只是「存在」的意义——因为神（或者我）知道，我平常那种活法离有意义差得远了。

lines.en: Speak to me, delinquent angel.
lines.zh: 说给我听吧，不良天使。

lines.en: Feed me your fears. Your concerns. And I will transform them into a means for you to escape the life you’ve grown to loathe.
lines.zh: 把你的恐惧喂给我。你的担忧。而我会把它们变成工具，让你逃离你已经开始厌恶的生活。

lines.en: I hate the water level.
lines.zh: 我讨厌水位线。

lines.en: : So, uhh...this job hunt sure is going great, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 呃……这次找工作的事进展得挺顺利的，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that actually what you were so afraid of talking about? Or is this just an excuse to stall?
lines.zh: : 这就是你那么怕开口要谈的事？还是说这只是你拖延的借口？

lines.en: : I don’t fuckin’ do this often, okay? I’ve gotta like...warm up or some shit.
lines.zh: : 我他妈又不常干这种事，行吧？我总得……热个身什么的。

lines.en: : You should have picked a better topic then, because your job hunt is going so poorly that I doubt we’d be able to squeeze even two minutes out of it.
lines.zh: : 那你该挑个更好的话题，因为你找工作找得这么惨，我怀疑我们连两分钟都榨不出来。

lines.en: : Is there, like...anywhere you think I should try next?
lines.zh: : 有没有……你觉得我接下来该试试的地方？

lines.en: : Not unless you’re okay with either wearing a maid costume or working alongside your mom.
lines.zh: : 除非你乐意穿女仆装，或者跟你妈一起上班。

lines.en: scene pluto20
: Oh, fuck off. My mom hasn’t worked a fuckin’ day in her life. Ain’t nobody in their right mind gonna hire her.
lines.zh: : 哦，滚你的。我妈这辈子一天都没工作过。脑子正常的人谁会雇她。

lines.en: : Fuck, dude. I’ve got a better shot at landing somethin’ than she does.
lines.zh: : 操，老兄。我找到工作的机会都比她大。

lines.en: : She actually just started working at Sana’s mom’s bar a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 她其实不久前刚开始在 Sana 妈妈的酒吧上班。

lines.en: scene pluto21
: Wait, you for real? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说真的？为什么？

lines.en: : Even if they don’t talk anymore, she’s got a bottomless wallet in my dad since she scares the shit out of him. She doesn’t have to work.
lines.zh: : 就算她们现在不说话了，我爸那个无底钱包也够她花的，她把我爸吓得够呛。她根本不用工作。

lines.en: : It’s not like I know {i}why{/i} she’s working. I just know she is.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道她{i}为什么{/i}要工作。我只知道她在上班。

lines.en: scene pluto22
: I wanna say “good for her,” but frankly, I really don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说「挺好的」，但说实话，我真不在乎。

lines.en: : She can try to make up for walkin’ out on her daughter as much as she wants, but I’m not the type to forgive people that easily.
lines.zh: : 她想怎么弥补当年抛下女儿的事都行，但我不是那种容易原谅别人的人。

lines.en: : I know that well from experience.
lines.zh: : 这点我从经验里很清楚。

lines.en: : Not like I think you {i}should{/i} forgive me or anything after what I did to you...
lines.zh: : 我也没觉得，在我对你做了那些事之后，你{i}该{/i}原谅我什么的……

lines.en: : But I know you’re not the type to really {i}want{/i} to do that in the first place because it makes it easier to shut people out.
lines.zh: : 但我知道你本来就不是那种真{i}想{/i}去原谅的人，因为不原谅更方便把人推开。

lines.en: : Don’t talk like you fuckin’ know me, dude. I don’t know what kinda shit you heard from my mom, but she doesn’t know me either.
lines.zh: : 别说得你他妈有多了解我似的，老兄。我不知道你从我妈那儿听了些什么屁话，但她也不了解我。

lines.en: : Am I wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错了吗？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter if you’re right or wrong. I just don’t want some douchebag pervert treating me like I’m some...friend or love interest or some shit.
lines.zh: : 你对不对都无所谓。我只是不想让某个变态色狼把我当成什么……朋友或者恋人之类的。

lines.en: : It’s shitty enough that you’re already cozying up to my fucking family.
lines.zh: : 你已经跟我家里人打得火热了，这本身就够恶心的了。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like I’m playing poker with your dad. I just hang out with your mom every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我又没在跟你爸打扑克。我只是偶尔跟你妈一起出去玩玩。

lines.en: : Is that really it?
lines.zh: : 真的只是这样？

lines.en: : Yeah. I have literally nothing to gain from lying to you about this.
lines.zh: : 嗯。在这件事上骗你，我一点好处都捞不到。

lines.en: : Now what? Would you prefer I told you I was dating her or something?
lines.zh: : 现在又怎么了？你是更希望我说我在跟她交往之类的？

lines.en: : Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: : I saw you.
lines.zh: : 我看见你了。

lines.en: : Saw me what? I haven’t even touched her.
lines.zh: : 看见我什么？我连她一根手指都没碰过。

lines.en: : Not with my mom.
lines.zh: : 不是跟我妈。

lines.en: : With...somebody else.
lines.zh: : 是跟……别人。

lines.en: scene pluto23
: See...this is the part where shit is gonna get really weird. Because no matter how I fuckin’ talk about this, it’s gonna sound like I’m crazy.
lines.zh: : 瞧……接下来这部分会变得特别怪。因为不管我他妈怎么说，听起来都会像是我疯了。

lines.en: : Well...the least I can do is pretend it’s not since you’re always snapping me out of mild hallucinations.
lines.zh: : 好吧……至少我可以假装你不疯，毕竟你总在把我从轻微的幻觉里拽出来。

lines.en: : You deserve to sound a little crazy after all you’ve done for me.
lines.zh: : 你为我做了那么多，值得拥有一次听起来有点疯的权利。

lines.en: scene pluto24
: Thanks. But just the idea of {i}you{/i} havin’ to give me a fuckin’ free pass to not feel like I’m insane kinda sucks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过一想到{i}你{/i}还得给我一张「不用觉得自己是疯子」的免费通行证，这事本身就挺操蛋的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...life kind of sucks. So it is what it is.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，嗯……生活本来就挺操蛋的。所以就这样吧。

lines.en: : You...uhh...
: I don’t really remember when it was...
lines.zh: : 我不太记得是什么时候了……

lines.en: : But a while ago, I was hangin’ out in some alleyway...
lines.zh: : 但不久前，我在某条小巷子里闲逛……

lines.en: : That could have been literally any night. That’s your favorite hobby.
lines.zh: : 那基本上可以是任何一个晚上。那是你最大的爱好。

lines.en: scene pluto25
: Yo, fuck off. I’m trying to actually tell you something.
lines.zh: : 喂，滚蛋。我是真想跟你说点事。

lines.en: : My bad. I thought that was funny.
lines.zh: : 我的错。我以为那句挺好笑的。

lines.en: scene pluto24
: Well, it wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : But...anyway, I was hangin’ out in some alley in the middle of the night when I heard a...familiar voice or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不过……总之，半夜我在某条巷子里闲逛的时候，听到了一个……很耳熟的声音什么的。

lines.en: : So I obviously got up to like...just {i}make sure{/i} I wasn’t...mishearing it or some shit.
lines.zh: : 所以我当然就起身去……{i}确认一下{/i}自己没有……听错什么的。

lines.en: : Let me guess...that familiar voice belonged to me?
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜……那个耳熟的声音是我的？

lines.en: : Yeah. Which isn’t weird by itself or whatever because like, you seem to basically {i}always{/i} be wandering around somewhere.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这事本身倒不奇怪，因为看起来你基本上{i}总是{/i}在什么地方游荡。

lines.en: : But...you weren’t alone that night.
lines.zh: : 但……那天晚上你不是一个人。

lines.en: : There was somebody else with you. And no, it wasn’t my fucking mom.
lines.zh: : 还有别人跟你在一起。而且不是，不是我他妈的妈。

lines.en: if yumiknows == True:
: If this is about me “cheating on” Chika or whatever you’re going to accuse me of-
lines.zh: : 如果这是要说我「出轨」了 Chika 或者要指控我别的什么——

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m fucking talking about, asshole. Just...listen to me.
lines.zh: : 我他妈说的不是这个，混蛋。你……听我说完。

lines.en: else:
: I mean, you know pretty much everyone I know. So if you saw me with somebody else-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我认识的人你基本上都认识。所以如果你看见我跟别人在一起——

lines.en: : Just fucking listen to me for a second.
lines.zh: : 你就他妈听我说一秒钟行不行。

lines.en: : It was...hard to tell with how dark it was and shit, so I can’t be sure that it was the same person, but...
lines.zh: : 当时太黑了什么的，看不太清，所以我不能确定是不是同一个人，但……

lines.en: : Then I remember hearin’ something about...clouds that...sounded a lot like somethin’ I remember from when I was a kid...
lines.zh: : 然后我记得听到了一些关于……云的东西……听起来很像我小时候记得的某件事……

lines.en: scene pluto26
: And then you...said a name.
lines.zh: : 然后你……说了一个名字。

lines.en: : Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori。

lines.en: : ...Okay? She’s a friend of mine. It’s not any more than that.
lines.zh: : ……然后呢？她是我朋友。就只是这样而已。

lines.en: : I doubt she’d even be capable of anything more than friendship given her...eccentricity.
lines.zh: : 鉴于她那种……古怪劲儿，我怀疑她连友情以上的关系都应付不来。

lines.en: : No, dude. That...
lines.zh: : 不，老兄。那……

lines.en: : I think that was my cousin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是我表姐。

lines.en: : Did she have like, different colored eyes and shit?
lines.zh: : 她是不是有一双……颜色不一样的眼睛什么的？

lines.en: : Yeah. Have you really never seen her around before?
lines.zh: : 嗯。你以前真的一次都没见过她吗？

lines.en: : She works at virtually every restaurant in Kumon-mi...and was also a popular online model or something for a while.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 几乎每一家餐厅她都干过……而且有段时间还是个挺火的网络模特什么的。

lines.en: : A: I don’t have enough money to go out to restaurants. And B: I only use my phone to make calls and shit.
lines.zh: : A：我没钱下馆子。B：我的手机只用来打电话什么的。

lines.en: : Either way, I can’t see why me hanging out with your cousin should be something you have to get all weird about bringing up.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我看不出我和你表姐来往有什么值得你这么别扭地提出来的。

lines.en: : It’s just one of life’s many coincidences.
lines.zh: : 这只是生活里众多巧合中的一个。

lines.en: scene pluto27
: Sure, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是，对。

lines.en: : It would’ve been all fine and dandy and totally normal except for the one minor detail that {i}I was pretty sure she was fucking dead.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一切都那么美好、那么正常，只除了一个小细节——{i}我相当确定她早就死了{/i}。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene pluto28
: I, like...didn’t have a lot of friends and shit when I was little.
lines.zh: : 我小时候……没什么朋友之类的。

lines.en: : But she used to come over a couple times a month and keep me company while my mom was getting high.
lines.zh: : 但她以前一个月会来几次，在我妈嗨翻了的时候陪着我。

lines.en: : But...she suddenly stopped coming over one day.
lines.zh: : 可……有一天她突然就不来了。

lines.en: : I tried asking why, but all anyone ever told me was that she was involved in some accident and hooked up to machines and shit.
lines.zh: : 我问过为什么，可所有人只告诉我她出了事故，靠机器维持着什么的。

lines.en: : And when I didn’t hear anything after a few years and stopped talkin’ to my family, I just assumed she never made it.
lines.zh: : 过了几年我什么消息都没听到，后来也不跟家里人联系了，我就当她没挺过来。

lines.en: : I mean...she has said some stuff about being in the hospital. And the whole accident thing lines up with the weird onomatopoeia she used to describe what happened to her...
lines.zh: : 我是说……她确实说过一些关于住院的事。而且事故那部分，跟她用来形容自己遭遇的那些奇怪的拟声词也对得上……

lines.en: scene pluto27
: Holy fuck...I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 我操……我完全不知道。

lines.en: : Has she said anything about like...family or whatever? What’s she like now?
lines.zh: : 她有没有说过……家里人之类的？她现在是什么样？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: That is...not an easy question to answer. Especially since I was pretty sure she was an alien until a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 这个……不好回答。尤其是直到几分钟前，我还挺确定她是个外星人。

lines.en: scene pluto30
: Uhh...what?
: Did she ever...speak strangely when you used to know her? Like...swapping out words for {i}other{/i} words and whatnot?
lines.zh: : 你以前认识她的时候，她说话有没有……很奇怪？比如……用{i}别的{/i}词替换掉原本的词之类的？

lines.en: : Not really. She was pretty normal apart from how she dressed and shit.
lines.zh: : 没有。除了穿衣打扮什么的，她挺正常的。

lines.en: : Well, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but she is very likely not the same person she used to be.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不想当那个带来坏消息的人，但她很可能已经不是从前那个人了。

lines.en: : She has a very particular...way of speaking now.
lines.zh: : 她现在有一种非常特别的……说话方式。

lines.en: : Kind of like she’s relearning not only everything about communication, but life itself.
lines.zh: : 有点像是在重新学习一切——不只是关于沟通的一切，还有关于生活本身的一切。

lines.en: : Great work ethic, though. Maybe you finally have a path to employment after all.
lines.zh: : 不过工作态度很好。说不定你终于找到就业的门路了。

lines.en: scene pluto31
: Nah.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : If she’s that fucked up, there’s no sense in showin’ up and confusing her even more.
lines.zh: : 如果她伤成那样，我跑去只会让她更混乱，没意义。

lines.en: : It’s just nice knowin’ she didn’t wind up in the dirt.
lines.zh: : 知道她没被埋进土里，就已经很好了。

lines.en: : Fuck, dude. I could have sworn I was gonna leave this conversation feelin’ like some sort of maniac-
lines.zh: : 操，老兄。我本来还以为聊完这段我会觉得自己像个疯子——

lines.en: : But to know that was actually her and not just some delusion is just...
lines.zh: : 可知道那真的是她、而不是我的幻觉，这感觉就……

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ wild.
lines.zh: : 就他妈的太野了。

lines.en: : You don’t even want to meet her? Or...well, {i}re{/i}-meet her, I guess?
lines.zh: : 你连见都不想见她？或者……好吧，{i}重{/i}新认识一下？

lines.en: scene pluto32
: Maybe some other time. Would probably wind up just makin’ me feel weird if I met her now and she was a totally different person. ‘Specially if it’s as bad as you make it sound.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。要是现在见了她，发现她完全是另一个人，大概只会让我觉得别扭。特别是在真像你说得那么严重的情况下。

lines.en: : If that’s what you want...
lines.zh: : 如果这是你想要的……

lines.en: : Welp...
lines.zh: : 行吧……

lines.en: : Guess that’s that, then.
lines.zh: : 那大概就是这样了。

lines.en: : Are you done opening up already? Or do you want to talk more about past experiences from your childhood that helped turn you into the person you are today?
lines.zh: : 你已经敞开心扉说完了？还是说你想再多聊聊童年那些把你塑造成今天这个人的经历？

lines.en: scene pluto33
: Come on, man. This actually went kind of well. Don’t ruin it by makin’ me bring up a bunch of shit that has nothing to do with...anything.
lines.zh: : 拜托，老兄。这次其实进行得还不错。别为了逼我翻出一堆跟……什么都不相干的破事，把它给毁了。

lines.en: : But we’re on a roll. What if there are more acquaintances of mine that you’re related to? We should just get them all out of the way now.
lines.zh: : 可我们正顺风顺水呢。万一我认识的人里还有别的跟你沾亲带故的呢？我们应该趁现在一次性解决掉。

lines.en: : Nah. I said all I needed to say.
lines.zh: : 不了。该说的我都说了。

lines.en: : Just gonna go for a walk or some shit and try to...I don’t know- come to terms with this, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我就去走走什么的，试着……我不知道——接受这件事吧，大概？

lines.en: : Fuckin’ weird thinking somebody's been dead for so long only to find out that they’re wandering around town talkin’ to your asshole teacher.
lines.zh: : 一直以为某个人死了那么久，结果发现她在城里晃悠、还跟你这个混蛋老师聊天，想想真他妈怪。

lines.en: : Yeah...I can only imagine how strange-
lines.zh: : 是啊……我只能想象有多奇怪——

lines.en: scene pluto34
: That-
: Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: Oh, how lovely it must be to have the world turned on its head.
lines.zh: 把世界彻底颠倒过来，一定很美妙吧。

lines.en: To discover that the misery you’ve wrapped yourself in is nothing but a shroud of misunderstandings and pessimistic assumptions.
lines.zh: 发现自己一直裹在身上的痛苦，不过是一层由误解和悲观臆测织成的裹尸布。

lines.en: What else have you shed tears over that was not worth shedding anything at all?
lines.zh: 还有什么是你曾为它落泪、却根本不值得你流一滴眼泪的？

lines.en: Have you bled yourself dry when you could have remained hydrated and healthy?
lines.zh: 你本可以保持水分充足、身体健康，却偏要把自己的血放干吗？

lines.en: Or, perhaps you enjoy the misery?
lines.zh: 或者，也许你就是享受痛苦？

lines.en: Perhaps it is the feeling of helplessness that you can throw yourself into that gives your life meaning.
lines.zh: 也许正是那种可以一头扎进去的无助感，赋予了你的生命意义。

lines.en: Because lack of meaning is meaning in itself.
lines.zh: 因为没有意义本身就是一种意义。

lines.en: And existing to be miserable gives you the only excuse you need to get yourself out of bed in the morning.
lines.zh: 而为了痛苦而存在，给了你早上爬起床所需的唯一借口。

lines.en: Where did Yumi go, you ask?
lines.zh: 你问 Yumi 去哪儿了？

lines.en: She left quite some time ago.
lines.zh: 她早就走了。

lines.en: But you’ve been here the whole time.
lines.zh: 可你从头到尾都在这儿。

lines.en: Watching minutes...hours tick by as you attempt to make sense of your existence through words on the screen.
lines.zh: 看着一分钟……一小时地流逝，试图通过屏幕上的文字，弄懂自己存在的意义。

lines.en: Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: 为什么一切都非得这么疼？

lines.en: That’s simple-
lines.zh: 很简单——

lines.en: Because you want it to.
lines.zh: 因为你想让它疼。
